question: Is each canonical FARA candidate primitive derivable from the remaining six candidate primitives?

criterion.requested_joint_test: For each P in the canonical set, either exhibit a model of an explicitly stated formal theory of the other six in which P's defining predicate is not definable, or give a lossless definition of P using only the other six, relative to a stated scope and objective.
criterion.canonical_boundary: The canonical Independence definition is only binary; Reduction additionally requires a specified scope and objective.
criterion.adjudication_rule: Independent requires a countermodel; derivable requires a lossless definition; equivalent requires both reductions under a stated equivalence relation; otherwise unresolved. Syntactic omission, failed search, examples, and downstream FAR/FARO behavior are not proofs.

shared_blockers: No formal signature, axioms, inference rules, model class, scope, objective, or equivalence relation is canonical for this seven-concept test.
The canonical binary Independence definition does not define independence from a set of six concepts.

The prose definitions use non-canonical notions including distinguishability, characteristic, association, mapping, semantic meaning, objective, conditions, and rules; treating those notions as primitives would add hidden assumptions.
Consequently no model can be certified as a model of the remaining primitives and no claim of complete, lossless definability can be checked.

results.attempt: Remove Object and read its definition as a candidate predicate: anything explicitly distinguishable.
results.exact_blocker: No domain or formal predicate for explicit distinguishability is specified, so a reduct/countermodel and lossless reconstruction cannot be formed.
results.dependency_observation: Property and Relation explicitly invoke object; Representation is itself defined as an object. Using any of them to recover Object would require proving that their object occurrences are eliminable rather than presupposing Object.

results.attempt: Remove Property and test whether 'a characteristic that an object may possess' is definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Characteristic, possession, and modality ('may') have no formal signatures or semantics.
results.dependency_observation: Object supplies a bearer but not a definition of characteristic or possession; substituting Relation would assume, without a registered equivalence, that every property is a relation.

results.attempt: Remove Relation and test whether an explicitly specified association of arity at least two is definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Association, explicit specification, arity, and satisfaction are not formalized.
results.dependency_observation: Encoding a relation as a Property of tuples requires tuple formation, n-ary satisfaction, and a property/relation equivalence not supplied by canonical authority.

results.attempt: Remove Representation and test whether an object used to denote, describe, encode, or refer is definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Denotation/reference and the role 'constructed or used' have no formal semantics or loss criterion.
results.dependency_observation: Interpretation is defined as assigning meaning to representations, so recovering Representation from Interpretation is circular unless Interpretation is independently reformulated without Representation.

results.attempt: Remove Interpretation and test whether a meaning-assigning mapping on representations is definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Mapping, semantic meaning, assignment, and equality of meaning are not formalized.
results.dependency_observation: Representation mentions different interpretations; using that clause to reconstruct Interpretation merely reuses the removed term and is circular.

results.attempt: Remove Investigation and test whether a reasoning objective together with pursuit conditions is definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Reasoning objective, conditions, and the together-with constructor lack a formal signature and identity criterion.
results.dependency_observation: Reasoning Calculus is explicitly defined within an investigation; reconstructing Investigation from Reasoning Calculus therefore presupposes the removed primitive.

results.attempt: Remove Reasoning Calculus and test whether rules governing admissible reasoning within an investigation are definable using the other six.
results.exact_blocker: Rule, admissibility, transformation, inference, criterion, and procedure are not formalized at the primitive layer.
results.dependency_observation: Investigation's context clause names reasoning calculi but supplies no rules; downstream FAR workflow or FARO operations cannot fill the gap without reversing the canonical dependency direction.

hidden_equivalent_candidates: Interpretation as a Relation or mapping
adversarial_findings.renamed_duplicate_result: No exact duplicate definition was found after case-folding and whitespace/punctuation normalization; semantic equivalence remains untestable without a registered equivalence relation.
adversarial_findings.downstream_dependency: No FAR or FARO artifact is used as an assumption or proof. Their methodology/operations are downstream and inadmissible for this test.

conclusion: W1 execution is complete, but all seven outcomes fail closed as unresolved. No primitive is established independent, derivable, or equivalent.
consequences: The seven items remain candidate primitives only.
FARA primitive independence and minimality remain unproved.
No theorem, necessity, irreducibility, or global theory claim may consume this execution as a positive result.
